fut2060.d: Start after the 2060 economic phase. You have every technology in the first two columns of the tree (except Signs of Life and Existing Life), and an extra $40B plus $3B for each technology you would have started a 2030 campaign with. Choose policies for the three missed economic phases. Every world starts with its exploration value reduced by 1.

d: Roll an extra die for settlement growth
Draw 1 extra politics marker each economic phase
Politics markers are worth 3 tech points

na.ab: Innovative: subtract 2 from the cost of a technology if you are the first to develop it.

eu.ab: Astronomy: roll an extra die for space telescope exploration and keep the better.

cn.ab: Reverse Engineering: technology costs -4 (instead of -3) per other faction that has it.

mil.d: Starts with Military Policy: embargoes rivals and builds armed ships.

rob.d: Starts with Robotic Policy: peaceful and versatile, focused on building bases.

as.ab: Strategic Resources: +1 resource production at bases.

sa.ab: Equatorial Launch Sites: launch vehicles carry one extra resource from Earth.

EVENTS: Raise one non-depleted world's exploration value by 2.
The player with the fewest earned missions earns $5B extra.
Base resource production is halved; every Mining Station and Refinery takes a damage marker.
Base research is halved; every Research Lab takes a damage marker.
Destroy 2 saved resources at every base; every Supply Station and Spaceport takes a damage marker.
A random world is struck: bases there damage every facility and lose half their resources.
The player behind in settlements plus missions draws 5 politics markers.
The player with the fewest settlements may transfer 5 resources this turn.
The player with the fewest settlements adds 2 settlements to a base.
All foreign relations move one step toward Neutral.
A random world draws a world card.
Roll to place an extra pirate.
Roll to place an extra asteroid.
The comet's exploration value rises by 3.
Alpha Centauri and Deep Space Astronomy each rise by 4.
Every CV away from a base or Earth takes 1 damage; REs away from a base are destroyed on a 1 or 2.
Ruins, First Contact, Artificial Intelligence, Incoming and Invasion need every player to agree; skipped in solo play.
